source.document_title: HEDIS MY2027 Volume 2: Technical Specifications for Health Plans
source.disclaimer: Derived from published NCQA HEDIS technical specifications to locate chart evidence. Not a certified compliance engine; all findings are proposals for human review.

universal_exclusions.label: Hospice care or intervention
universal_exclusions.note: Any hospice encounter or hospice intervention retires the member
universal_exclusions.timing: Any time during the measurement year

universal_exclusions.label: Palliative care
universal_exclusions.note: Palliative care retires the member for the measures that list it — confirm this measure does
universal_exclusions.timing: Any time during the measurement year

universal_exclusions.label: Advanced illness with frailty (age 66+)
universal_exclusions.applies_when: Age 66 or older as of the end of the measurement year
universal_exclusions.note: Compound: requires BOTH a frailty indicator AND an advanced-illness indicator (or long-term-institutional status) in the measurement year, for members 66+. A single mention of either alone does not qualify.
universal_exclusions.timing: Indicators during the measurement year; age evaluated as of the anchor date

eligible_population.event_or_diagnosis: Members with a hypertension diagnosis during the first six months of the measurement year

measures.numerator: The most recent blood pressure reading in the measurement year is < 140/90 mmHg.

data_elements.label: BP reading date
data_elements.timing: Most recent reading in the measurement year
data_elements.compliance_hint: Use the most recent reading on or before Dec 31

data_elements.label: Systolic
data_elements.timing: Most recent reading in the measurement year

data_elements.label: Diastolic
data_elements.timing: Most recent reading in the measurement year

data_elements.label: Setting
data_elements.compliance_hint: Outpatient, remote monitor, or member-reported device

data_elements.label: Performing provider credential
data_elements.compliance_hint: Capture the performing provider's signature/credential where the measure requires it

exclusions.label: ESRD, dialysis, or kidney transplant
exclusions.note: ESRD, chronic dialysis, or a functioning kidney transplant retires the member
exclusions.timing: Any time in the member's history through the end of the measurement year

exclusions.label: Pregnancy during the measurement year
exclusions.timing: Any time during the measurement year

eligible_population.event_or_diagnosis: Women in the eligible age range
eligible_population.continuous_enrollment: October 1 two years prior through December 31 of the measurement year

measurement_period.lookback: Mammogram within 27 months prior to the end of the measurement year

measures.numerator: One or more mammograms any time on or between October 1 two years prior and December 31 of the measurement year.

data_elements.label: Mammogram date
data_elements.timing: Within 27 months of the period end
data_elements.compliance_hint: Any mammogram in the 27-month look-back counts

data_elements.label: BI-RADS assessment
data_elements.compliance_hint: Supporting context, not required for the numerator

exclusions.label: Bilateral mastectomy
exclusions.note: Compound: a documented BILATERAL mastectomy qualifies on its own; a UNILATERAL mastectomy qualifies only with the contralateral side (left AND right) or a documented history of the other. A lone 'mastectomy' mention is not sufficient — confirm laterality.
exclusions.timing: Any time in the member's history through the end of the measurement year
